verses.text: Ee \nd Bwana\nd*, ulionyesha wema kwa nchi yako.
Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, uturejeshe tena,
Utuonyeshe upendo wako usiokoma, Ee \nd Bwana\nd*,
Nitasikiliza lile atakalosema Mungu aliye \nd Bwana\nd*;
Hakika wokovu wake uko karibu na wale wamchao,
Naam, hakika \nd Bwana\nd* atatoa kilicho chema,
